name: Shizuku
source:
A cool-looking girl who is the vocalist-guitarist of a band. In contrast to her stand-offish appearance and tattoos, she's a very kind girl. She's close friends with both [url=/c140281]Nana[/url] and [url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url].
